question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "Insigt."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that is misspelt is **"Insigt."**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Insight."**
 
• It means a deep understanding of what somebody/something is like. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की विस्‍तृत या गहन जानकारी)
 
 
• **Example**: *The book gives a good **insight**__ into the lives of the poor.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Supply: **a store or amount of something that is provided or available to be used. (आपूर्ति, सप्‍लाई)
 
• **Optical: **connected with the sense of sight. (दृष्टि-विषयक, दृष्टि-शक्ति बढ़ाने से संबंधित)
 
• **Cares: **to be worried about or interested in somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की चिंता करना या उसमें रुचि रखना)
